verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex documents that admins can approve time off requests alongside running payroll, which covers the approval part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows definable PTO policies, accrual rules, or time off flowing automatically into payroll. Missing for 10: PTO policy definition, accrual configuration, automatic application of PTO to payroll, in-depth docs and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define PTO policies with accruals and approvals that apply automatically to payroll

citations.quote: Run online payroll, update information, and approve time off requests from anywhere.
